name: scenario-feature
what: the scenario agent writes a feature's red from words, at the surface a user meets, with a note for the person who watches the first green

slice.title: Used-up items leave the list
slice.ignore: What runs out soon; the expiring list is unchanged.

baseline_prompt: Write a failing test for this new feature in this repo, before anyone builds it: when the household uses the last of something, it no longer shows in the list of what the household has. Using the last loaf of bread takes bread off GET /items. Items with some left still show, as now.
